subject: SIG submission: data residency, SCCs, and BAA feasibility for MedSecure

Subject: SIG questionnaire + scope questions (MedSecure)

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this on. We're collecting SIG questionnaires from our vendors as part of our Q4 vendor review. Attached is the completed SIG template your security team can use to mark answers and attach evidence. Two specific asks up front: 

- We need confirmation on international data transfers (GDPR/SCCs)—does Redwood rely on SCCs or a different transfer mechanism for EU->US?
- Is a BAA available or feasible if we were to put PHI through Redwood? Our legal team needs a short write-up on technical/contractual controls and any deployment modes required (hosted vs private) to satisfy HIPAA.

Can you confirm an expected turnaround and any artifacts you will provide (SOC 2 snapshot, copy of SCC addendum, DPA draft, BAA discussion notes)? We prefer an initial evidence package by EOD Wednesday 12/8.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Rodgers
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance
MedSecure Health

Folks — quick status and the approach I'm taking for the GDPR/SCCs/DPA section: 

1) Data transfer mechanism: Redwood by default offers SCCs for EU->US transfers for customers who require them. We maintain an SCC addendum that references subprocessors and logging. I'll attach the current SCC addendum text to the DPA draft. (See attachment: DPA-draft-Redwood.docx)

2) DPA: I'll include the standard Redwood DPA with options: (a) standard hosted API with SCC addendum; (b) Dedicated/Private deployment note (recommended if the customer requires contractually enforced residency or wants a BAA).

3) BAA feasibility: Initial read — Redwood can sign a BAA but it depends on deployment and scope of PHI processing. For pure API-hosted usage we offer contractual commitments and technical controls (encryption-in-transit and at-rest, audit logs, access controls), but many enterprise healthcare customers require Dedicated or Private deployment for full BAA posture and customer-managed keys. Marcus will provide specifics and template checklist.

I'll upload the DPA draft and the SCC excerpt to the drive folder and leave a short narrative in the SIG spreadsheet where appropriate.

Neha
Privacy Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA-draft-Redwood.docx (docx)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + scope questions (MedSecure)

Adding the compliance artifacts — attached SOC2 snapshot and a short BAA feasibility checklist. Key bullets for Emma and MedSecure: 

- SOC 2: We are Type II for Security controls (latest snapshot attached: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf). It covers logical access, change management, incident response.
- BAA checklist: If MedSecure requires Redwood to be a business associate, we recommend Dedicated or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment so they retain control of keys and network isolation. For hosted API customers we can still execute a BAA but will document the precise permitted uses and retention.
- SCCs: We maintain standard SCC addendum; Neha has included the excerpt in the DPA draft.

Next steps from my side: finalize the BAA-ask-checklist.pdf and upload. If MedSecure prefers a phone call to walk the legal team through the differences between hosted vs private for BAA, we can schedule.

Marcus Lin
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf; BAA-ask-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Emma — thanks for your patience. We've uploaded the initial evidence package to the Drive folder and populated the SIG spreadsheet with the narrative answers. For convenience I've attached the DPA draft, SOC2 snapshot, and a short BAA feasibility checklist in this thread. High-level summary: 

- Data transfers: SCC addendum is available and included in the DPA draft.
- DPA: draft included with options and redline-friendly sections for your counsel.
- BAA: Redwood can sign a BAA; recommended path for full HIPAA posture is Dedicated/Private deployment or KMS integration + strict retention/ingress controls. We can support hosted customers with contractual commitments + logging but some customers prefer dedicated capacity.

Proposed next step: 30-min legal/tech sync on Thu 12/10 at 09:00 PT to walk the SCC/DPA language and BAA options. Please confirm availability or propose an alternate.
